title: What is the PwC and Strategy& interview process, and how should you prepare?
description: How PwC consulting and its strategy arm Strategy& hire: CV screening, online tests, candidate-led cases, group cases and presentations.
hook: PwC has one of the largest consulting businesses in the world, and its strategy arm, Strategy&, is a well-known strategy brand in its own right. They recruit separately, so it is worth knowing which one you are applying to.
body:
PwC consulting and Strategy&

Strategy& was formerly Booz & Company and is now PwC's strategy consulting business. It recruits separately from the rest of PwC and runs a demanding case process.

The usual steps

  1. CV and cover letter screening.
  2. An online test, depending on country and route.
  3. Interviews combining behavioural questions and case interviews.
  4. In some processes, a group case or an individual presentation.

The cases

Prep guides describe PwC and Strategy& cases as candidate-led, similar in style to BCG and Bain. Practise driving the case, from structure through to recommendation.

How to prepare

  • Practise candidate-led cases and at least one presentation-style case where you prepare alone, then present.
  • Prepare clear answers to why PwC or why Strategy&, mentioning the kind of work you want.
  • If a group exercise is part of your process, practise contributing without dominating.

Sources

  • IGotAnOffer: PwC (Strategy&) case interview
  • My Consulting Offer: The PwC case interview
  • Hacking the Case Interview: Big Four consulting firms

Checked November 2026. Processes change by office and year, so always confirm with the firm's own careers page and your recruiter.

Strategy& and other PwC roles need different preparation

Suppose a payments company wants to enter the small-business lending market. A strategy case should address the size and profitability of the opportunity, likely customer segments, existing competitors, credit losses, funding costs, regulatory constraints and whether the client has an advantage. A technology-delivery interview might examine underwriting workflows, data quality, platform integration and controls. Both are legitimate consulting problems, but the emphasis differs.

If the proposed loan portfolio is £200 million at an 8% yield, with 4% funding cost and 2% expected annual credit losses, the simplified spread is £4 million before operating costs and capital charges: £16 million income minus £8 million funding and £4 million losses. A candidate who simply calls the 8% rate "revenue" without considering credit risk has missed the economics.

Prepare one original story about your analytical contribution and another about influencing people without authority. Verify the interview format directly. Recruitment processes and practice names change across countries and roles, so treat public candidate reports as examples rather than guaranteed steps.
